newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgium names U.N. soldier killed in Serb enclave.
newsitem.headline: Belgium names U.N. soldier killed in Serb enclave.

text.p: The Belgian Defence Ministry said on Friday that a Belgian soldier killed in a shooting incident in the Serb-controlled town of Vukovar in eastern Croatia earlier in the day had died in the line of duty.
It named him as Corporal Olivier Gossye.

Defence Minister Jean-Paul Poncelet said in a statement that an inquiry had opened to determine whether the death of Gossye, who was serving with the U.N. Transitional Administration in Eastern Slavonia (UNTAES), was the result of an isolated criminal act or an attempt at destabilisation.
A Jordanian soldier and an UNTAES civilian officer were wounded in the incident.
Vukovar is the biggest town in the Serb-held region of Eastern Slavonia which is due to return to Croatian government rule by mid-June.

A series of incidents have increased tension there as the local Serb population becomes increasingly nervous with the approach of the deadline for the "peaceful reintegration" of the region into Croatia.
